name: Planet
summary: Ringed planet with banded colours and a tilted ring, for space scenes. Anim: spin, float.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the ring is about 680 px wide, body 380 px

params.name: color
params.note: body colour; the bands are shades of it

params.name: anim
params.note: spin = bands slide across the body; float = bobs gently
